entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:1
segments: ¶How beautiful are your feet in their shoes, O king's daughter! The curves of your legs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a good workman:

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:2
segments: Your stomach is a store of grain with lilies round it, and in the middle a round cup full of wine.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:3
segments: Your two breasts are like two young roes of the same birth.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:4
segments: Your neck is as a tower of ivory; your eyes like the waters in Heshbon, by the doorway of Bath-rabbim; your nose is as the tower on Lebanon looking over Damascus:

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:5
segments: Your head is like Carmel, and the hair of your head is like purple, in whose net the king is prisoner.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:6
segments: How beautiful and how sweet you are, O love, for delight.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:7
segments: You are tall like a palm-tree, and your breasts are like the fruit of the vine.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:8
segments: I said, Let me go up the palm-tree, and let me take its branches in my hands: your breasts will be as the fruit of the vine, and the smell of your breath like apples;

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:9
segments: And the roof of your mouth like good wine flowing down smoothly for my loved one, moving gently over my lips and my teeth.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:10
segments: ¶I am for my loved one, and his desire is for me.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:11
segments: Come, my loved one, let us go out into the field; let us take rest among the cypress-trees.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:12
segments: Let us go out early to the vine-gardens; let us see if the vine is in bud, if it has put out its young fruit, and the pomegranate is in flower. There I will give you my love.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:13
segments: The mandrakes give out a sweet smell, and at our doors are all sorts of good fruits, new and old, which I have kept for my loved one.
